lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots aligned in approximately four horizontal rows, most prominent in the mid-lateral zone posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse high-intensity pixels intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid pattern; intersections are most defined in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and low-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low to moderate density of high-luminance blobs distributed across the dorsal fin surface, with a notable cluster of smaller spots near the posterior base of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular indentation on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; jagged, uneven margin observed on the distal tip of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of approximately eight small yellow pilot fish near the snout and multiple elongated remoras attached ventrolaterally.
